newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks firmer in strong business.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks firmer in strong business.

text.p: Croatian stocks mostly firmed in strong business on Tuesday.
* Of 18 active issues 10 rose, four fell, three were flat and one traded for the first time.
* Volume more than doubled to 37,035 shares, turnover also rose to 28.7 million kuna.
* Top gainer hotelier Istraturist added 10 kuna or 6.3 percent to 170 kuna on volume of 741 shares.
* Biggest decliner Dalmatinska Banka lost 29 kuna or 9.1 percent to 309 kuna with 105 shares sold.
* Most active shipyard Viktor Lenac sold 15,563 shares, inching up one kuna to 156.
* Dubrovacka Banka I-series made its market debut, selling 1,662 shares at 7,700 kuna each.
